name: hacocoon-agent-workspaces
description: Create isolated Hacocoon worktrees and Environments for VS Code coding-agent sessions.

hacocoon.agentWorkspace.gitExecutable.description: Git executable on the VS Code extension host. Commands are executed without a shell.

hacocoon.agentWorkspace.adapterExecutabl.description: haco-agent-host executable on the VS Code extension host. Use a trusted wrapper executable when Hacocoon is reached through WSL or another client bridge.

hacocoon.agentWorkspace.worktreeRoot.description: Root for VS Code-created linked worktrees. Empty uses a .hacocoon-worktrees directory beside the repository. ~/ is expanded on the extension host.
